law.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (4)
law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a one-way highway onto a two-directional highway, the left turn must be made by passing to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered upon leaving the intersection, and the approach for the left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.

activation_conditions: the subject turns left from a one-way highway onto a two-directional highway
residue: 'as close as practicable' is a judgement element
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the approach near the left curb precedes entry; the exit right of the centreline follows
approach and exit are both needed
